svg.title: SUS-I1 boundary and interfaces
svg.desc: SUS-I1 boundary and interfaces. Inside the boundary: SUS-A1 Dockable observation UAV, SUS-GSE Ground support, maintenance supports, charging and test equipment, SUS-I1-INT Integration manager and PX4 command adapter, SUS-M1 Piloted walker, SUS-A1-FC PX4-based flight controller, SUS-A1-NAV Navigation sensors, camera and telemetry, SUS-A1-PROP Motors, ESCs and propellers, SUS-A1-PWR UAV battery and power management, SUS-M1-CTL Mission, motion and balance control, SUS-M1-DCK UAV dock, retention, charging and release, SUS-M1-MAN Manipulation arms and end effectors, SUS-M1-PIL Pilot station, restraints, displays and controls, SUS-M1-PWR Power generation, storage, distribution and thermal control, SUS-M1-SAF Independent safety monitor, protective stop and isolation, SUS-M1-WLK Chassis, legs, joint actuators and stability sensing, SUS-M1-PWR-BAT Battery pack, BMS and contactors, SUS-M1-PWR-DIST Protected power distribution, SUS-M1-PWR-GEN Engine-generator and governor. Outside: EXT-AIRSPACE Airspace, people and property under the UAV, EXT-BYSTANDER Bystanders, EXT-CREW Ground crew and maintainers, EXT-GNSS-RF GNSS and RF environment, EXT-OBSERVER Safety observer, EXT-PILOT Pilot, EXT-TERRAIN Terrain and obstacles, EXT-WEATHER Weather. Connectors: EXT-AIRSPACE–SUS-A1: IF-007; EXT-BYSTANDER–SUS-M1-WLK: IF-012; EXT-CREW–SUS-M1-PWR: IF-008; EXT-GNSS-RF–SUS-A1-NAV: IF-013; EXT-OBSERVER–SUS-M1-SAF: IF-011; EXT-PILOT–SUS-M1-PIL: IF-001; EXT-PILOT–SUS-M1-SAF: IF-015; EXT-TERRAIN–SUS-M1-WLK: IF-010; EXT-WEATHER–SUS-A1: IF-014; SUS-A1–SUS-M1-DCK: IF-006; SUS-A1-FC–SUS-A1-PROP: IF-021; SUS-A1-FC–SUS-I1-INT: IF-PX4-001, IF-PX4-002, IF-PX4-005, IF-PX4-006, IF-PX4-008; SUS-A1-NAV–SUS-M1-PIL: IF-PX4-007; SUS-A1-PWR–SUS-M1-DCK: IF-PX4-009; SUS-GSE–SUS-M1: IF-019; SUS-I1-INT–SUS-M1-CTL: IF-PX4-004; SUS-I1-INT–SUS-M1-DCK: IF-PX4-003; SUS-I1-INT–SUS-M1-PIL: IF-020; SUS-M1-CTL–SUS-M1-MAN: IF-018; SUS-M1-CTL–SUS-M1-PIL: IF-017; SUS-M1-CTL–SUS-M1-WLK: IF-004; SUS-M1-PWR–SUS-M1-SAF: IF-005; SUS-M1-PWR-BAT–SUS-M1-PWR-DIST: IF-003; SUS-M1-PWR-DIST–SUS-M1-PWR-GEN: IF-002; SUS-M1-SAF–SUS-M1-WLK: IF-016, IF-022.
